cases.name: Omnath, Locus of All
cases.text: At the beginning of your first main phase, look at the top card of your library. You may reveal that card if it has three or more colored mana symbols in its mana cost. If you do, add three mana in any combination of its colors and put it into your hand. If you don't reveal it, put it into your hand.

cases.name: Example Alpha
cases.text: At the beginning of your first main phase, look at the top card of your library. You may reveal that card if it has four or more colored mana symbols in its mana cost. If you do, add three mana in any combination of its colors and put it into your hand. If you don't reveal it, put it into your hand.

cases.name: Example Beta
cases.text: At the beginning of your first main phase, look at the top card of your library. You may reveal that card if it has three or more colored mana symbols in its mana cost. If you do, add two mana in any combination of its colors and put it into your hand. If you don't reveal it, put it into your hand.

cases.name: Example Gamma
cases.text: At the beginning of your first main phase, look at the top two cards of your library. You may reveal that card if it has three or more colored mana symbols in its mana cost. If you do, add three mana in any combination of its colors and put it into your hand. If you don't reveal it, put it into your hand.
